gloss: in the middle of; right in the midst of; during

definitions.gloss: in the middle of; right in the midst of; during
definitions.explanation: Indicates being right in the middle of an action or situation, often when something unexpected happens or interrupts. Stronger than just 'during' — it emphasizes the exact moment within an ongoing activity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最中|さいちゅう}に⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
examples.english: The phone rang in the middle of my meal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最中|さいちゅう}に⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: An earthquake occurred in the middle of the meeting.

examples.japanese: {試験勉強|しけんべんきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最中|さいちゅう}に⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: A friend came to hang out right when I was studying for exams, which was a problem.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{最中|さいちゅう}→最中：02821_saichuu⟧ (in the midst of) and the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Often used when an interruption or unexpected event occurs during an ongoing activity.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Attaches to nouns or verb dictionary form + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧:
- ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最中|さいちゅう}に: in the middle of eating
- ⟦{話|はな}している→話す：00467_hanasu⟧{最中|さいちゅう}に: in the middle of talking
- ⟦{寝|ね}ている→寝る：00470_neru⟧{最中|さいちゅう}に: while sleeping

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ～⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: during — more neutral, less emphasis on 'right in the middle'
- ～て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: halfway through — emphasis on the midpoint of a process
- ～⟦{最中|さいちゅう}→最中：02821_saichuu⟧だ: to be in the middle of (predicative) — ⟦{今|いま}まさに→今まさに：17479_imamasani⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最中|さいちゅう}→最中：02821_saichuu⟧だ (I'm right in the middle of work)

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse ⟦{最中|さいちゅう}→最中：02821_saichuu⟧ (in the middle of) with ⟦{最中|もなか}→最中：28020_monaka⟧ (a traditional Japanese wafer cake filled with bean paste). Same kanji, different readings and meanings.
